prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. A pair of knitted mittens overlapping gently, clear separate thumbs, broad ribbed cuffs with only three lines and a single snowflake motif.
Elegant simple hand-drawn dark contours and white empty interiors. No gray shading, no fabric knit texture, no tiny repeated ridges, no extra motifs. Any requested snowflake is one simple six-arm shape without tiny branching details. Complete subject within 10 percent clear margins.
